What is the area of the triangle $△ABC$ shown above?

(Figure not drawn to scale)
worked_solution:
The area of the triangle is defined as 

$$
A=\frac{b\cdot h}{2},
$$

 where $b$ is a base and $h$ is the corresponding height.

From the diagram, we see that the base is 

$$
b=AB=5\,\text{m}
$$

and the corresponding height is 

$$
h=12\,\text{m}.
$$

Therefore, the area is

$$
\begin{aligned}A & =\frac{b\cdot h}{2} \\  & =\frac{5\cdot 12}{2} \\  & =\frac{60}{2} \\  & =30\,{\text{m}}^{2}.\end{aligned}
$$
